Junior Cybersecurity Analyst in 12 weeks.

Cybersecurity training with Apex, powered by CyberBit: a cloud-based simulation and skills platform for hands-on upskilling through realistic, scalable, on-demand cyber exercises.

Start a 7-day free trial Plan options

Our approach

The 12-week programme fast-tracks a learner into the industry with the foundational knowledge, hands-on experience and recognised skills to launch a career as a Junior Cybersecurity Analyst.

A structured curriculum combines instructor-led sessions, hands-on labs and real-world simulations. Participants learn:

  1. Cybersecurity fundamentals, networking and threat detection
  2. How to analyse security logs and respond to incidents like a SOC professional
  3. Ethical hacking techniques and vulnerability management
  4. Industry best practices, compliance standards and security frameworks
  5. Preparation for the CompTIA Security+ certification
Length
12 weeks

Instructor-led sessions, labs and simulations
